### LOW: Debug cache\-KEK\-from\-file path is not reflected in the cache threat model
[docs/architecture/security/encryption\.md:113](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/233195ac475538cd2c82a084125c96129a615463/docs/architecture/security/encryption.md#L113) · A-001, T-041

The encryption doc now describes a DEBUG\-build path where the SSD cache KEK is derived from an operator\-created file \(\`DARKBLOOM\_DEBUG\_CACHE\_KEY\_FILE\`\)\. That file is protected only by ownership, mode 0600 and volume encryption, not the Secure Enclave\. T\-041 and its KEK\-wipe, HMAC\-lookup and at\-rest mitigations assume the KEK is rooted in the Secure Enclave\. A local process or operator that reads the file can decrypt DBK3 prompt\-derived KV artifacts and recompute the HMAC lookup keys, which undercuts the leak\-\#2 closure\. The doc says release builds do not contain this path, but the implementation \(\`SSDDebugCacheKeyFile\.swift\`\) is not in the supplied evidence, so that claim is unverified\. T\-041 and its detection hints should record this as a build\-gated weaker key\-custody mode\. A release\-build compile\-out check and a test that a release binary ignores the env var should also be required\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5

### LOW: Threat model lacks coverage for the new DEBUG\-only SSD cache KEK\-from\-file override
[docs/reference/configuration\.md:578](https://github.com/Layr-Labs/d-inference/blob/233195ac475538cd2c82a084125c96129a615463/docs/reference/configuration.md#L578) · A-001, T-041, TB-003

This PR documents \`DARKBLOOM\_DEBUG\_CACHE\_KEY\_FILE\`\. It replaces the Secure Enclave/Keychain\-rooted SSD cache KEK with one derived from an operator\-created plaintext file, and the result is reported as persistent\. T\-041 treats the Secure Enclave\-rooted KEK as the root of AES\-GCM wrapping, of the K\_lookup HMAC names, and of the KEK\-wipe purge\. A file\-held KEK removes that hardware root for any build that has the path\. The doc says release builds do not compile the path, and it requires mode 0600, a single link and a non\-symlink final component\. The supplied evidence cannot confirm either the compile\-time exclusion or the file checks, because only documentation changed\. T\-041 mitigations and detection\_hint do not mention this override\. Suggested fix: add the DEBUG\-only file\-KEK path to T\-041 and TB\-003 \(file path: SSDDebugCacheKeyFile\.swift; the compile\-out guard\); add a release\-build test that the symbol is absent\. Also record that KEK destruction is no longer a cryptographic purge when the key lives in a file\.

Raised by: anthropic/claude\-sonnet\-5\.5
